heading: Discover, go, listen — the same three taps everywhere in the venue
subhead: One platform runs the whole guest journey, from discovering events once they arrive, to a guest looking for dinner or a fan looking for kick-off.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Guest opens the app and sees what's on - event style entertainment , match or music, today.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: They see what's on and plan their evening.

steps.title: Go
steps.text: Head to the the zone, connect on wi-fi, connect to the audio.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: For TV events, they tune their phone to the right channel. Sound follows them, not the wall.

steps.title: Return
steps.text: More reasons to stay on-site — and more reasons to come back next Tuesday.
